payload.note: The public O(1,1) species Wightman Gram has exact signature (1,1), so no positive Hilbert vacuum representation can retain that two-point function while treating Omega and Upsilon as individually Hermitian. The public fundamental symmetry kappa does produce the positive Gram I, but necessarily changes the Hilbert adjoint to Omega*=Upsilon, equivalently T*=T and X*=-X. More generally, a Krein-selfadjoint observable is Hilbert-selfadjoint exactly when it is ghost-even; the ghost-odd part becomes physical only after multiplication by i. An exact weak-ghost fixture has generalized Krein Born weight 2 and ordinary Hilbert Born weight 3, proving that Hilbertization does not silently preserve the public probability rule. Consequently a positive local-net realization is not ruled out, but the compact quadrupole must first be shown kappa-even (or decomposed with controlled parity and domains). The existing detector certificate does not establish that condition. General Eq. (19), its physical quotient, a positive BT local net, gravity and Lorentzian certification remain open.
